summary: Iteration 4 features fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests pass (10 new for iteration 4 + 25 regression). Login returns boats array (Maria=[Poseidon,Sereia,Vento Sul], Carlos=[Aurora,Estrela do Mar], João=[Netuno], Admin=[]). POST/PUT /api/requests accept and persist boat_name and observation for both descida and subida. Frontend (375x667 mobile viewport): (1) Maria's Solicitar Descida — descida-boat-select opens modal listing exactly 3 boats (Poseidon/Sereia/Vento Sul) and selecting Sereia updates the field label. (2) Maria's Solicitar Subida — subida-boat-select shows 3 options and Vento Sul selection works. (3) subida-observation-input exists, accepts text, value round-trips correctly. (4) João (1 boat) opens Descida with boat pre-selected to 'Netuno'. (5) Admin (00000000000) is redirected to Painel da Marina and the mode-quadro toggle renders a Lancha/Descida/Subida table with 19 rows for today; first row 'Aurora | 09:00 | 14:00' and rows with '*' correctly mark expected-return times (e.g., 'Netuno 09:00 14:00*'). (6) Toggle back to mode-lista shows the 35-row detailed list. (7) Alterar Descida (Maria) shows requests with boat names (e.g., 'Aurora', 'Netuno') proving item.boat_name reflects the selected boat. No regressions detected on cancel/confirm-return/history/day endpoints.
action_items: No action required for iteration 4 features — everything works as specified.

(Carry-over from iteration 3) admin filter chips (filter-todas/descida/subida) were reported broken on react-native-web due to ScrollView pointer capture; not in scope for this iteration but still worth verifying if not already fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:182 correctly falls back to user.boat_name when payload.boat_name is None — good defensive default so legacy clients that don't send boat_name still work.

descida.tsx:66-67 / subida.tsx:61-62 both compute boatList = u.boats || [u.boat_name] and pre-select boatList[0] on create-mode — clean approach that gracefully handles single-boat clients (dropdown still opens but shows only 1 option).
SelectField uses Modal + Pressable options which works correctly on react-native-web (unlike the horizontal ScrollView filter chips from iteration 3).

admin.tsx quadroRows builds each row by joining today's descidas with matching subidas by boat_name — clean single-pass computation; asterisk clearly distinguishes real subida requests from expected-return placeholders.
RequestBase model correctly makes boat_name and observation optional so both types can share the same schema.
server.py update_request re-validates the merged doc via validate_request_payload — ensures partial PUT can't produce an invalid state.
seed_data_creation: Test suite created ~10 additional descida/subida requests today for CPFs 11111111111, 22222222222, 33333333333 with boat_name and observation fields populated. Test data prefixed with TEST_. Admin panel showed 19 descidas / 14 subidas / 4 retornos after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SelectField options render with testID pattern `{parent-testID}-option-{value}` e.g. `descida-boat-select-option-Sereia`. Login button testID is `login-submit-button` (NOT `login-button`). Home logout testID is `logout-button`. Admin logout testID is `admin-logout`. Admin mode toggle: `mode-lista` / `mode-quadro`. Quadro rows: `quadro-row-{id}`. Admin list rows: `admin-row-{id}`. Alterar rows: `alterar-row-{id}` with `cancel-request-{id}` and `confirm-return-{id}` actions.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 4 scope.
